papers.title_en: Past as State, Present as Attention: Persistent-State Blockwise Flow Matching for Long-Horizon Co-Speech Motion Generation
papers.authors: Yi Liu, Xiangyue Zhang, Jianfang Li, Jia Ma, Yisheng He, Jianqiang Ren
papers.evidence: 用于长时程共语人体动作生成的分块流匹配
papers.tldr: 长时共语音动作生成需同时保持时序连贯与风格一致，现有逐段方法依赖短近因易漂移，或保留过长显式历史而代价高、难学习。PASPA利用“过去为状态、当前为注意力”的非对称性：块间持久状态紧凑总结缓慢变化的风格，块内双向自注意力建模快速局部动态，并置于分块流匹配框架。公开基准上取得最优FGD，并在长序列生成中保持动作风格，为长时生成提供高效可扩展方案。
papers.abstract_en: Co-speech motion generation remains challenging over long horizons due to the need for temporal coherence and consistent style. Existing methods typically generate long motions segment by segment, either conditioning on a short seed of recent frames, which gradually drifts, or retaining ever-longer explicit histories, which are costly to maintain and hard to learn from limited data. We trace these limitations to a key asymmetry between past and present: past motion carries slowly varying style that should be compactly summarized, whereas the current segment exhibits fast-changing local dynamics that require fine-grained modeling. This asymmetry motivates a simple Past-As-State, Present-as-Attention principle for long-horizon co-speech motion generation. Following this principle, we propose PASPA, which summarizes past history with an inter-block persistent state and models the current segment with intra-block bidirectional self-attention. We instantiate PASPA within a blockwise flow matching framework, with multi-block supervision for effective training over variable histories, prefill-decode state caching for efficient rollout, and hybrid classifier-free guidance for enhanced history and speech conditioning. Extensive public-benchmark experiments show that PASPA achieves state-of-the-art FGD performance and preserves motion style across long-sequence generation.

papers.title_en: ViT-H: Generative Video-To-Humanoid Control with Motion Tracking Feedback
papers.authors: Zimo He, Tianyi Bian, Zizhong Yang, Hongjie Li, Nan Jiang, Jieming Cui, Baoxiong Jia, Yizhou Wang, Siyuan Huang, Yixin Zhu
papers.evidence: 扩散模型直接从视频生成人形参考运动
papers.tldr: 从单目人类视频学习人形全身控制时，现有“重建—重定向—跟踪”流水线分阶段独立优化，难以利用下游跟踪反馈提升动作可执行性。ViT-H采用“生成—跟踪”范式，用扩散模型直接从视频生成人形参考动作，绕过重建与重定向，并用跟踪结果做直接偏好优化后训练。其自回归变体支持低于400毫秒延迟的实时视频遥操作。在Unitree G1上，ViT-H的动作质量与可执行性优于现有流水线，并随模型和数据规模良好扩展。
papers.abstract_en: Learning humanoid control from monocular human videos offers a scalable way to acquire diverse whole-body behaviors. Yet, existing reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines are limited in system-level scalability by separately optimized intermediate stages and cannot directly optimize reference motion executability using downstream tracking feedback. We present ViT-H, a video-to-humanoid control framework following a generation-and-tracking paradigm. ViT-H directly generates humanoid reference motions from videos with a diffusion model, bypassing human motion reconstruction and retargeting, and uses motion-tracking outcomes to post-train the generator with direct preference optimization. We further introduce an autoregressive variant that enables real-time humanoid video teleoperation with sub-400 ms latency. Extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 demonstrate that ViT-H outperforms state-of-the-art reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines in both motion quality and executability. We further show that ViT-H scales favorably with model size and with both pre-training and post-training data scale, while motion-tracking feedback consistently improves executability across different motion trackers.

papers.title_en: StackGen3D: Stable 3D Block Stack Generation from Multiview Silhouettes
papers.authors: Xiaopeng Zhang, Luzhe Sun, Yiqing Xu, Matthew R. Walter
papers.evidence: 条件流匹配用于三维积木结构生成
papers.tldr: 从三视图轮廓生成稳定积木结构需处理几何歧义与块间支撑。StackGen3D 先用物理信息图神经网络预测稳定性并筛选训练数据，再用条件流匹配学习符合轮廓的多模态配置。推理阶段以轻量几何选择与修正减少穿模；Best-of-10 将稳定率由45.3%提升至72.4%，轮廓IoU为0.970。该框架展示了关系物理推理与生成建模结合用于创意3D组装的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Generating physically stable 3D structures from visual specifications requires resolving geometric ambiguity while accounting for physical interactions among objects. We present StackGen3D, a framework for generating stable block assemblies conditioned on a given block inventory and three orthographic silhouettes. Our approach consists of two stages. First, we develop a physics-informed graph neural network (PI-GNN) that models support relations between blocks and serves as a fast stability predictor for curating a diverse dataset of stable structures. Second, we train a conditional flow-matching model on this dataset to capture the multimodal distribution of block configurations consistent with the target silhouettes. At inference time, lightweight geometric selection and refinement reduce inter-block penetration without physics simulation. Preliminary experiments show that the PI-GNN generalizes from simple stacks to complex structures substantially better than a parameter-matched multilayer perceptron. For structure generation, Best-of-10 selection improves physical stability from 45.3% to 72.4% while achieving a silhouette IoU of 0.970. These results highlight the potential of combining relational physical reasoning, scalable data curation, and conditional generative modeling for creative 3D assembly.   Project website: [https://ripl.github.io/StackGen3D-web/](https://ripl.github.io/StackGen3D-web/)

papers.title_en: HAF-VLA: Hierarchical Action Flow Framework for Humanoid Vision-Language-Action Control
papers.authors: Langzhe Gu, Chengkai Hou, Meng Li, Xinhua Wang, Xinyuan Lv, Shuanghao Bai, Guangrun Li, Jingyang He, Ziluo Ding, Zhiyuan Xu, Ning Ding, Kuan Cheng, Jian Tang, Shanghang Zhang, Zhengping Che
papers.evidence: 基于流匹配的人形全身动作生成
papers.tldr: 人形机器人在高维全身动作空间中协调移动、姿态、注视与双臂操作十分困难，基座或腰部的小误差容易引发上肢剧烈补偿。HAF-VLA 基于预训练流匹配 VLA，继承视觉-语言前缀编码器与动作专家权重，并引入可学习阶段嵌入与跨阶段 KV 缓存条件。它把全身动作块分三阶段渐进去噪：先移动与头部指令，再腰部细化，最后全身操作。六项真实任务显示其显著提升现有人形移动操作性能。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid robots hold great promise as general-purpose agents in human-centered environments, yet adapting generalist vision-language-action (VLA) policies to real-world humanoid loco-manipulation remains challenging. Unlike fixed-base or wheeled manipulators, humanoids must coordinate locomotion, posture, gaze, and dual-arm manipulation over a high-dimensional whole-body action space, where inaccurate base or waist motions can easily induce unstable and aggressive upper-body compensation. We propose HAF-VLA, a hierarchical action-flow framework for humanoid VLA control. Built upon a pretrained flow-matching VLA, HAF-VLA inherits the vision-language prefix encoder and action expert weights, and adapts them to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation with learnable stage embeddings and cross-stage KV-cache conditioning. Instead of generating the full action chunk in a single pass, HAF-VLA progressively denoises a shared whole-body action space: first locomotion and head commands, then waist refinement, and finally full-body manipulation. To preserve structural dependencies across stages, we introduce a cross-stage KV cache conditioning mechanism, enabling subsequent action generation stages to refine and augment their outputs based on the action representations from preceding stages. Experimental results across six real-world tasks demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances the performance of existing models in humanoid loco-manipulation tasks, demonstrating an effective pathway for adapting strong mobile-manipulation VLAs to humanoid whole-body loco-manipulation.

papers.title_en: Latent Space Jam: Layout Guided Video Synthesis
papers.authors: Asaf Joseph, Moshe Mandel, Ohad Fried
papers.evidence: 免训练视频扩散用于布局与运动控制
papers.tldr: 视频生成中引入布局控制通常需要额外训练，带来算力、数据与架构改动的负担。本文提出免训练两阶段方法：先用提示引导的交叉注意力调控时空布局，生成粗略视觉引导；再由该引导条件化同一预训练扩散模型，输出高质量且布局一致的视频。实验显示其在重叠与轨迹准确度、视觉质量上稳定优于先前工作，并支持多样轨迹与物体交互。
papers.abstract_en: Adding control to video generation often requires training, which demands additional computational resources, data, or architectural changes. We propose a training-free approach that utilizes pretrained video diffusion models to control object layout and motion using coarse layouts. Our method operates in two passes: first, it steers spatiotemporal placement through prompt-guided cross-attention to produce a coarse visual guide; second, this guide conditions the same model to generate a high-quality, layoutconsistent video. The approach enables coordinated motion with strong temporal consistency, supporting diverse trajectories and object interactions without additional training. Extensive experiments show that our method consistently outperforms prior work in overlap and trajectory accuracy, as well as visual quality across static, dynamic, and multi-object scene settings.

papers.title_en: Learning Domain Trajectories with Flow Matching for Gradual Domain Adaptation
papers.authors: Yubo Huang, Yushe Cao, Zixi Wang, Jingzehua Xu, Xin Lai, Xiongyu Hu, Shuai Zhang
papers.evidence: 流匹配学习时变速度场实现连续传输
papers.tldr: 针对大分布偏移下的领域适应，现有渐进域适应多采用离散分步迁移，易累积误差且依赖不稳定的Min-Max优化。FlowGDA将渐进适应建模为表示空间中统计流形上的连续传输，学习时间相关速度场以生成平滑域轨迹。方法用无模拟回归目标替代对抗训练，并结合源锚定传输与语义一致性损失抑制语义漂移。实验显示其优于现有方法，表明flow matching可作为域适应的有效新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Large distribution shifts remain a primary obstacle for domain generalization and unsupervised adaptation. Although gradual domain adaptation alleviates this difficulty by introducing ordered intermediate domains, most existing approaches still operate in a discrete, step-wise manner, which can accumulate errors and often relies on unstable Min--Max optimization. We propose \textbf{FlowGDA}, a flow-matching framework that models gradual adaptation as \emph{continuous} transport on a statistical manifold in a representation space. FlowGDA learns time-dependent velocity fields that induce smooth domain trajectories, using a simulation-free regression objective rather than adversarial training. To prevent semantic drift, we couple left-to-right transport between consecutive domains with a source-anchored transport and a semantic consistency loss, and we further stabilize learning via a two-stage sequential optimization scheme. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art techniques, validating flow matching as an effective alternative for domain adaptation.

papers.title_en: Coupling Execution Horizon and Sampling Depth in Flow-Matching VLA Policies
papers.authors: Jiabing Yang, Yuan Xu, Yixiang Chen, Qisen Ma, Peiyan Li, Kai Wang, Chenhang Cui, Tao Yu, Zichen Wen, Wen Ye, Bowen Fang, Ziheng He, Xiangnan Wu, Yingda Li, Yan Huang, Liang Wang
papers.evidence: 流匹配模型生成连续轨迹
papers.tldr: 流匹配VLA在机器人操作中需兼顾实时性与执行稳定性，但采样深度与执行时域通常被解耦处理。本文揭示二者存在系统性符号反转的计算—执行耦合：粗积分在快速重规划下降低精度，却在长开环执行中抑制漂移并提升性能。基于此将采样深度作为部署期方差调节旋钮，在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0与真实Franka上跨π0、π0.5、GR00T验证，无需训练或改架构即可提升成功率并显著降低推理延迟。
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generate expressive continuous trajectories for robotic manipulation, yet balancing real-time responsiveness with execution stability remains a persistent challenge. Standard deployment workflows typically treat numerical solver depth and execution horizon as decoupled choices. The horizon amortizes inference latency, while solver depth is kept high to preserve integration fidelity. In this paper, we reveal a fundamental compute-execution coupling in flow-matching VLAs governed by a systematic sign reversal. While coarse numerical integration degrades precision under rapid replanning, it markedly improves task performance under extended open-loop commitment. Geometrically, numerical truncation contracts lateral action dispersion around an invariant trajectory centroid, serving as an implicit regularizer that suppresses compounding open-loop drift. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world Franka manipulation on representative VLA backbones including $π_0$, $π_{0.5}$, and GR00T, exploiting this joint coupling consistently achieves superior task success while drastically lowering inference latency, entirely training-free and without architectural modifications. These findings establish numerical sampling depth as an operational variance regulator, shifting its role from a static precision budget to an active deployment knob in robot learning. Project page: https://jiabingyang01.github.io/Horizon-Depth-VLA/
